description: This file is a command-line interface (CLI) script for a universal project initializer tool. It handles project configuration parsing, template creation, and project setup commands, supporting various project types and providing functionalities such as generating minimal configs, converting paths, and outputting JSON responses. It also includes a command to retrieve the run command for specific project types.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated key=value string into a dictionary with type conversions for booleans, integers, and floats.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from command-line arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig instance for retrieving template info, primarily for internal use.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a provided base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Transforms a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary suitable for JSON serialization, converting init file paths to absolute paths.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs a standardized JSON response indicating success or failure and includes template configuration details if available.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specified project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the logic for retrieving and outputting the run command for a given project type via CLI arguments.

ctags.name: output_json
ctags.pattern: /^def output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_pat/
ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
